item.title: Contested urbanisms: The politics of heritage and housing in Jakarta’s kampungs
item.description: Paper title: Contested urbanisms: The politics of heritage and housing in Jakarta’s kampungs. Here is the abstract: Do heritage-making projects resist or advance gentrification in Southeast Asia? Like other Global South cities, contested urbanisms chequer Jakarta’s postcolonial urban landscape. Competing ideas about urban development manifest in various ways of seeing and producing the city, as demonstrated by evictions, revitalisation projects, and informal housing. item.description: Paper title: Essays on the economics and geography of Big Science.
